limits: Actual shell dispatch and verdict with owned fake uv/make, no live git repository. uv argv models installed or absent 3.11; removing no-download writes an owned marker and returns fixture-ready, never fetches. Synthetic runner JSON is a fixture transcript, not real gate execution. Installed and Make-only populations are positive controls. Independent missing-tool/present127 classification is registered separately at controls/flow-finish-missing-tools, since selection anchors cannot be blind to that distinct refusal. Native dual-runtime behavior is tested separately. Existing-environment cases use owned pyvenv.cfg and executable interpreter doubles: mismatched 3.12 and broken interpreters must refuse before uv; matching 3.11 must run. A real 3.12 environment and its file fingerprint are covered by tests/test_cpp_environment_preservation.py.

anchors.why: Removes the named CPP runtime policy from the real invocation; absent 3.11 can then be reported ready by the owned provider.
